Settings

Display
Saira OFL · width 50, black italic for headlines
Text
Saira OFL · width 100 for reading
Moves
condensed, true italic, width as hierarchy
Mood
fast, competitive, loud, local
Case
Headlines in capitals, true italic (the drawn italic, not a slanted roman); fixtures and body in sentence case.
Numerals and features
font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums

15:00 · 19:45 · Row 1215:00 · 19:45 · Row 12

Kick-off times and seat rows in tabular figures.
Signature
A narrow black italic headline that leans forward, cut by the right edge of the screen on desktop (it wraps on a phone), with fixtures in the same family at normal width. Speed comes from the drawn italic and the cut, not from motion.
Use when
Clubs, leagues, fitness, running events, sports media and betting-free fan sites.
Turns into slop when
When the italic is faked with a skew transform, when the score is set as a giant number, or when speed lines and motion blur are added.
Offline
Without network the page falls back to the system stacks in --f-display and --f-text; no font files ship with this specimen.
